method: Exact enumeration and analytical integration of shared uniforms/exponentials; no Monte Carlo.
scope: One act, three act-local event ordinals; O always eligible, L at gold >=100, H at gold >=125; fixed gold histories; per-condition ID sequences shared; rare checks pass; no wrapping.
metric: Probability of the same event ID at a corresponding ordinal, averaged equally across ordinals and distinct unordered history pairs. A stress suite, not a model of gameplay frequencies.
checks: Every paired model reproduces the full vanilla single-run condition/visit-index path distribution; refreshing preserves matched-prefix probabilities and same-selection state alignment.

models.flat: One fixed uniformly shuffled condition schedule.
models.family: Freeze the L/H internal schedule when its whole family is unavailable.
models.highFirst: Exact vanilla conditional probabilities reconstructed from observed history; fresh H-first shared gates per event opportunity.
models.lowFirst: Same conditional-probability model with O-first gates.
models.resetHigh: Refresh only unpassed scheduling entries per act-local event ordinal; sample each attempted label with H-first gates, decrementing every attempted label.
models.resetMiddle: Same refresh with L-first gates, a control that groups O and H.
models.resetRace: Same refresh with fresh shared exponential priorities weighted by remaining scheduling counts on every attempt; no paused clocks.
